rejected_claims: No integrated four-layer trust chain was demonstrated; source modules cannot establish deployment or fail-closed enforcement across layers.
Approval auto-approval exists; blanket all-production-denied conclusion is not established.
Checkpoint Protocol is not a new authority provider and does not require retroactive authority gating for ordinary source development.
Production is not a supported institutional lifecycle transition; Draft cannot be promoted merely by editing a record.
JSONL append has no demonstrated atomic/multi-writer guarantee.
Approximate agent test counts were not accepted as observed execution evidence.

alternative_cause: The institutional gap is portable trust integration, not demonstrated ineffectiveness of existing agents.
